title: Frontier Dispatch

selected_categories.reasoning: The game continuously spawns hostile enemies around the player, creating sustained pressure that must be managed while protecting the implied supply route objective and advancing through a short combat scenario.
Moment-to-moment play is centered on staying alive under constant enemy pursuit, managing health, movement, healing, and threat spacing until the objective chain is complete.
The run culminates in a distinct boss encounter that acts as the final gating event after a brief combat phase, though the game has only one boss rather than a sequence of bosses.
The player attacks in real time from an avatar viewed from an external perspective and can fire a projectile skill, but the game is primarily top-down melee-action rather than a conventional shooter.
Combat takes place in a bounded arena-like field with repeated enemy engagements, kiting, and spacing, but progression is lighter and less duel-focused than a pure arena fighter.

uncertainty_notes: The category universe does not include a direct 'top-down action RPG' or 'arena survival action' label, so the closest matches were selected.
A shooting category is only a partial fit because the default attack is melee and only one swappable skill behaves like a projectile.
The quest wrapper and NPC dialogue are important to presentation but not dominant enough to classify this as a story-choice or interactive-novel experience.
